title: Reconifex
extract:
Reconifex is  Cyte-09's signature heavy assault rifle. Pressing the reload button between the outlined brackets will speed up the reload and load the gun with  Heat bullets.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Puncture damage.
Pressing the reload button while between 22% to 38% of the way through a reload will decrease the reload time to 1 second and grant the current magazine  Heat rounds that inflict 25% more damage with guaranteed status.
Perfect reload range is indicated by white brackets.
Advantages over other Primary   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
High crit chance (28.00%)
Above average sustained DPS (401.06)
Very high magazine size (200)
Very high ammo pickup (80)
Very high ammo max (1,000)
Above average fire rate (8.00 attacks/sec)
Very high crit multiplier (2.80x)
Disadvantages over other Primary   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
Low damage per shot (60.16)
Below average total damage (40)
Low accuracy (1.00° to 5.00°)
Very low reload speed (5.00 s)
Low status chance (16.00%)
Low disposition (●●●○○ (1.00x))
See WARFRAME Wiki:Stat Comparison/Percentiles for more details.

Acquisition
Reconifex's main blueprint is awarded from Höllvania Central Mall Bounties as a rare drop, requiring the completion of The Hex to access. The Barrel, Receiver, and Stock are awarded from Höllvania Legacyte Harvest and Hell-Scrub.
Alternatively Reconifex's blueprints can be purchased from Amir of  The Hex for  Standing; component blueprints for  5,000 and the main blueprint for  15,000, all requiring Rank 4 - Hot & Fresh.

All drop rates data is obtained from DE's official drop tables stored on Module:DropTables/data.
See Mission Rewards#Standard Missions for definitions on reward table rotations.
For more detailed definitions and information,
visit here.

Notes
The bonus damage is added as an Extra Hit that deals 25% of the initial hit's damage as pure  Heat damage with a guaranteed status effect.
The extra hit's damage cannot crit, or have its element changed, but does take into account critical and elemental damage increases of any type to the initial hit.
This means that the forced  Heat status' damage is affected both by Heat damage bonuses, and elemental damage bonuses, including Heat.
Faction Damage Bonus is applied once each to the initial hit, the extra hit, and the forced status, each application multiplicative with the previous.
Other damage modifiers such as Status Damage, Weakpoint Damage, Damage Vulnerability, and Damage Efficacy behave normally and apply once.
 Oraxia's  Silken Stride's  Toxin damage will override the  Heat bonus.
 Uriel's  Demonium runes will cause the Reconifex's innate  Heat bonus to be removed when the buff expires.
